title.narrative: Fighting corruption through civil society action

description.narrative: Consortium of core funding (organisational strategies, results frameworks and organisational budgets) for TI-S (consortium lead), the UNCAC Coalition and Global Anti-Corruption Consortium (TI and OCCRP)The development objective of the development cooperation among the parties is to accelerate impact in the global fight against corruption by combining the strengths of civil society advocacy, investigative journalism and coalition building TI outcome: Effective evidence-based advocacy conducted by anti-corruption civil society actors across Transparency International’s seven strategic objectivesOutcome indicator: Number and description of systemic changes in law, policy, practice or accountability following civil society-led advocacy; target = 5 / yearValue of the contract is 18,000,000 DKK + GACC separate 6,000,000 DKK, total 30,000,000 DKK

participating-org.narrative: Denmark - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Danida

recipient-country.narrative: This is a global project and is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany.
